describe: The image shows a carved roof trim ornament, a tall finial with a pointed spire rising from a bulbous stepped body, with two curved wing-like flanges sweeping out to the left and right and a flat ledge along the bottom edge. The surface is weathered dark brown wood with streaky grain, warm and mid-dark in tone, brightest on the upper left of the spire and in shadow where the flanges meet the body. Transparent background between the flanges and around the spire.
